title: The Proverbs of Scotland
author: Alexander Hislop

authorInfo.bio: Alexander Hislop (1807–1865) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Proverbs of Scotland" by Alexander Hislop is a collection of traditional Scottish proverbs compiled in the late 19th century. This compilation not only features a wide range of proverbs but also provides explanatory notes and a glossary, aimed at preserving the cultural wisdom encapsulated within these sayings.
